evidence: Both A and B contain human and mouse studies.
All selected contrasts are aerobic exercise.
Both A human studies are cycling; B human studies use knee extension or an incompletely reported baseline protocol. Mouse studies are treadmill in both patterns.
Protocols differ by study; B includes 80% VO2max and maximal exhaustion, but moderate exercise also occurs in B and intensive exercise in A.
Both patterns contain immediate and 3–4 h sampling.
Vastus lateralis and quadriceps occur across patterns; gastrocnemius occurs only in one A study.
Human studies are paired and mouse studies use independent groups in both patterns; this is confounded with species.
All B studies use Illumina HiSeq 2500; A is heterogeneous (HiSeq 2500, HiSeq 2000, NovaSeq 6000). HiSeq 2500 is not exclusive to B.
PolyA and ribo-zero occur across patterns; preparation and layout largely follow study/species.
Reported studies are predominantly male; sex is missing for GSE71972.
Available A human metadata include trained; B includes active or sedentary. Most A samples and all mouse studies lack this field.
